summary_en: Full-year dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027 raised to 60 yen per share from 50 yen, reflecting upward revision of operating profit guidance and strong performance in electronics and semiconductor materials segments.
title_en: Notice Regarding Upward Revision of Full-Year Business Performance Forecast and Modification (Increase) of Dividend Forecast for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027
translation_en_brief:
Achilles Corporation revised upward its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, increasing the year-end dividend per share to 60 yen from the previously announced 50 yen. This adjustment followed a significant upward revision to the company's full-year business performance, in which consolidated operating profit was increased by 2.4 billion yen (109.1%) to 4.6 billion yen.

The company attributed the improved outlook to strong performance in the electronics and semiconductor segments, particularly in films for electronic applications and electrostatic discharge protection materials for semiconductor wafer transport. Despite concerns about ongoing business uncertainty related to Middle East conditions, these core segments are expected to maintain solid momentum through the fiscal year.

The dividend revision reflects management's commitment to stable shareholder returns under a medium-term management plan targeting a dividend payout ratio of at least 30% and a minimum annual dividend of 50 yen per share. The company initially set the year-end dividend at 30 yen, then raised it to 50 yen in August 2026 due to gains from reducing strategic equity holdings, and has now increased it further to 60 yen based on the strengthened earnings outlook.
